question: Within a radius of 90 kilometers, where can I locate museum on the journey from New Mexico Slaughter House, Albuquerque, NM to 3 Studios Gallery, Santa Fe, NM?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'museum' AND ST_Intersects( geometry :: geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%3 Studios Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Santa Fe%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 ) ) :: geography, 90000 ) );
